title: Figure 12: FLAPS Antenna With a Cross-Shorted Dipole Array
description: Illustration of a flat parabolic surface (FLAPS) antenna: a dish face covered in rows of X-shaped crossed dipoles, with arrows showing RF energy from a feed horn reflected off the surface. The caption reads "Figure 12. FLAPS Antenna With a Cross-Shorted Dipole Array." The text explains that the Active Denial System uses this flat antenna and introduces the Vlasov antenna.
